en.tour.pi.welcome.title: Welcome to Purchase Invoices

en.tour.pi.tips.body: Good light, flat document, full frame, sharp text — that's the recipe for accurate OCR.

en.tour.pi.preview.body: Always glance over the extracted fields before saving — you can edit anything that looks off.

en.tour.pi.row.body: Click any row to review the OCR output, fix mistakes, then mark it verified.
en.tour.pi.retry.title: Retry failed scans
en.tour.pi.retry.body: If a scan failed, use Retry OCR to rerun the AI without re-uploading the file.
en.tour.pi.analytics.title: Reports & insights
en.tour.pi.analytics.body: Spend trends, VAT breakdown and category charts. Filter by any date range.
en.tour.pi.kpis.title: Live KPIs
en.tour.pi.kpis.body: See spend, VAT reclaimable, success rate and unverified count at a glance.
en.tour.pi.top.title: Top merchants
en.tour.pi.top.body: See where your money goes — the 10 biggest suppliers in your selected period.
en.tour.pi.export.title: Export anywhere
en.tour.pi.export.body: Download CSV for accountants, XLSX for spreadsheets, or NAV XML for tax filings.
en.tour.pi.replay.title: Need a refresher?
en.tour.pi.replay.body: Click Replay tour any time to walk through these steps again.
